title: 第一卷 第13章 女修凌霜第一卷 第14章 噬灵蛊
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: “娶了秦秀云？”
林逸眉毛一挑，一阵心动。
但旋即，他就摇头。
“赵川是我兄弟，我下不去那个手！”
“再说娶她娘俩，护道税增加四块下品灵石，我们现在也负担不起！”
“再等等吧！”
林逸一本正经道。
有钱的话，他肯定多多娶妻。
只要娶妻，就能变强。
不单是亲秀玉，还有牙行的颜如玉，他都想娶过来。
没钱就只能是空想。
灵石钱庄借贷的二十块下品灵石，想要归还，都还很费劲呢！
晚饭后。
林逸又拉着刚娶过门的王雨馨，走进洞房。
红烛摇曳，映着王雨馨羞红的脸。
“夫君，要不今晚就别了吧……”
“我都吃不消了！”
王雨馨娇滴滴说道。
看着她娇羞可人的面容，林逸愈发忍不住。
“雨馨，我们得勤加耕耘！”
“这样你才能早点怀孕，给我们云梦城林氏，添丁进口！”
林逸嘿嘿一笑，温声哄道。
现在没钱娶妻。
柳婉儿和阮红菱，都怀孕了。
想要让本命仙族灵树，再次结果。
就只有让王雨馨怀孕这一个办法了。
红烛缓缓流淌。
人影晃动。
浅吟低唱。
云雨过后。
林逸和王雨馨相拥而眠。
白发老者和娇羞少女，看起来很是反差。
翌日清晨，林逸早早起床，神清气爽！
穿好衣衫，来到院中，深吸一口气！
秋日的空气带着一丝凉意，院里的灵蔬长得翠绿欲滴，鸡圈里传来咯咯的叫声！
柳婉儿挺着微微隆起的肚子，在鸡圈边喂鸡。
阮红菱坐在院中石凳上择菜！
“红菱，你怀着身子，别太劳累！”
林逸走过去，笑着关切道。
“没事，又不是什么重活！”
阮红菱温婉一笑！
一家人吃过早饭，柳婉儿拉着林逸去看鸡圈！
“夫君，你瞧那只淡青色的小鸡，又长大了不少！”
柳婉儿兴奋道。
林逸顺着她手指的方向看去！
content_en:
"Married Qin Xiuyun?"
Lin Yi raised his eyebrows and his heart skipped a beat.
But immediately, he shook his head.
"Zhao Chuan is my brother, I can't do that!"
"Besides, marrying her and his wife will increase the protection tax by four pieces of low-grade spiritual stones. We can't afford it now!"
"Wait a little longer!"
Lin Yi said seriously.
If he had money, he would definitely marry more wives.
As long as you marry a wife, you can become stronger.
He wanted to marry not only Qin Xiuyu, but also Yan Ruyu, a dental practitioner.
Without money, it can only be a fantasy.
It is very difficult to return the twenty yuan of low-grade spiritual stones borrowed from the Lingshi Bank!
After dinner.
Lin Yi took Wang Yuxin, who had just married, into the bridal chamber.
The red candle flickered, reflecting Wang Yuxin's blushing face.
"Husband, why don't we say goodbye tonight..."
"I can't bear it anymore!"
Wang Yuxin said delicately.
Looking at her shy and lovely face, Lin Yi couldn't help it anymore.
"Yuxin, we have to work harder!"
"This way you can get pregnant as soon as possible and give us the Lin family of Yunmeng City a baby!"
Lin Yi chuckled and coaxed in a warm voice.
There is no money for a wife now.
Liu Waner and Ruan Hongling are both pregnant.
I want my natal fairy tree to bear fruit again.
The only way was to make Wang Yuxin pregnant.
Red candles flowed slowly.
The figure shakes.
Sing softly.
After the clouds and rain.
Lin Yi and Wang Yuxin hugged each other and slept.
The white-haired old man and the shy girl looked very different.
The next morning, Lin Yi got up early and felt refreshed!
Put on your clothes, come to the courtyard, and take a deep breath!
There is a hint of coolness in the autumn air, the spiritual vegetables in the yard are growing green, and there is a clucking sound from the chicken coop!
Liu Waner, with her slightly bulging belly, was feeding the chickens by the chicken coop.
Ruan Hongling was sitting on a stone bench in the courtyard choosing vegetables!
"Hong Ling, you are pregnant, don't be too tired!"
Lin Yi walked over and said with concern with a smile.
"It's okay, it's not a heavy job!"
Ruan Hongling smiled gently!
The family had breakfast, and Liu Waner took Lin Yi to see the chicken pen!
"Husband, look at that light blue chick, it has grown a lot!"
Liu Waner said excitedly.
Lin Yi looked in the direction of her finger!
